steps.what: Contribute equipment expertise and source requirements for maintenance procedures
Draft the proposed maintenance standard operating procedure contribution

loop.purpose: Organise supplied technical requirements into a procedure draft
loop.input: Technical brief and identified manufacturer passages
loop.output: Draft contribution with each instruction linked to supporting evidence
loop.check: Repairer checks sequence, device applicability, limits, warnings and required competence against source instructions; unsupported actions are removed
loop.stop: One revision then manual drafting if safety-critical ambiguity remains
loop.why_not_simpler: A template supplies headings but cannot organise variable technical instructions without interpreting their meaning

steps.what: Review and submit the technical procedure contribution to its owner

tasks.design: Use a bounded drafting tool to structure the repairer's contribution in {DOCS}. The repairer checks technical meaning and submits a versioned contribution to the procedure owner in {OTHER}, the maintenance system; it is not an authorised procedure release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Expert notes must be rewritten into a consistent procedure structure.
tasks.enabler_now: Procedure-draft generation with human review is available.
tasks.still_hard: Device applicability and whether an instruction is safe and complete.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer recognises practical failure modes and omitted precautions.
tasks.altitude: Less draft composition with unchanged expert input and review.

reach.learn: Document control and technical release boundaries

evidence.claim: MaintainX provides a procedure generator that drafts checklists for review before release. This supports drafting capability rather than validated medical-device procedure content.

assumptions: Boundary is the repairer's contribution, excluding the clinical engineer's formal approval, validation testing and procedure release. Those downstream activities retain existing effort.

Repairer produces device identifiers and revisions, applicable source passages, work sequence, limits, hazards and unresolved questions in s1. Its full 40 hours include collecting and entering these inputs; missing instructions are clarified manually.

The draft cannot become an active maintenance instruction through s3. Normal owner approval remains outside this task; two additional owner hours for generated-content review are counted as other-role upkeep.
Test existing templates and native maintenance-system drafting first. Four focal quality-sampling hours are additional per 100 baseline hours.
research_questions: Does structured drafting save contribution time after source capture and technical correction?

already_counted.description: Check and correct technical draft meaning

incremental.description: Sample draft quality and maintain templates
Additional owner review of generated-content failures

approvals.approved_version: Exact proposed contribution text, device revisions and source passages; changes void submission approval; this is not procedure release

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+21+25=86; gross 14 less 4 focal upkeep gives net 10. Low 2 allows eight extra technical correction hours. Expert input and review retain time; E1 scenarios.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Supervise or advise subordinate personnel during medical equipment maintenance

tasks.design: Keep supervision and practical advice with the experienced repairer. Existing instructions in {DOCS} support the discussion without replacing observation or intervention.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staff capability and the equipment situation vary.
tasks.enabler_now: Accessible instructions support consistency but do not establish a shorter supervisory interaction.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing when a subordinate needs intervention or escalation.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer sees how work is actually performed and adapts guidance.
tasks.altitude: Supervisory time and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate support for less experienced staff

evidence.claim: Practical supervision relies on contextual observation and interpersonal guidance; records software alone does not replace it.

assumptions: Boundary is direct supervision and advice, excluding separate work allocation and performance records.
Supervisor observes work during the full-time step; no structured competence score or automatic worker monitoring is assumed.
Use existing procedures before introducing software.
Zero incremental upkeep because the supervision workflow is unchanged. Subordinate labour remains unchanged and outside the focal denominator.
research_questions: Which supervisory delays reflect separate administrative tasks rather than necessary guidance?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net 0. Direct supervision and advice retain their full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compute wiring and equipment load requirements

steps.what: Establish load requirement inputs and applicable standard formulas
Make computations using algebraic expressions and standard formulas
Check load computations and accept the requirements calculation

tasks.design: Configure a validated calculation template in {OTHER}, the existing engineering calculator, with explicit units and method selection. The repairer supplies checked inputs, reviews dimensional and applicability checks and accepts the exact result; this does not authorise an installation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated arithmetic and unit handling are performed manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Standard formulas can be implemented and tested deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the applicable method and verifying actual installation conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer recognises when a standard formula does not fit the equipment or environment.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive arithmetic with unchanged engineering judgement.

reach.learn: Units, method applicability and verification boundaries

evidence.claim: Explicit standard load formulas can be calculated deterministically; input selection and applicability still require human judgement. The estimate is E1.

assumptions: Boundary is calculation and acceptance of requirements, excluding physical survey, equipment changes and installation release.

Repairer produces equipment identifier, rated loads, voltage, phase, power factor where needed, duty assumptions, installation conditions, units and selected method identifier in s1. Its full 35 hours include reading specifications, entering values and resolving missing inputs manually.
Technical authority maintains approved formula versions and limits. Added method review costs two other-role hours; five focal hours test calculations and monitor exceptions per 100 baseline hours.

Test existing engineering calculator templates before custom code. Missing inputs or out-of-scope conditions block output and require manual calculation; existing arithmetic runtime earns no labour saving.
research_questions: Does a validated template reduce operator arithmetic after input capture and independent checking?

already_counted.description: Check method applicability and accept the calculation

incremental.description: Test formula versions and review calculation exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact input values, units, formula version, method selection and resulting calculation; changes void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+0+20=55; gross 45 minus 5 focal upkeep gives net 40. Low 12 allows 28 hours for nonstandard calculations and missing input resolution. Input selection and final checks retain time; E1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce draft writing and repeated arithmetic while retaining supervision and engineering applicability decisions.
reach: Coordinate procedure review with maintenance supervisors
role.ambitious_version: A repairer who contributes clear procedures and checked calculations with explicit human acceptance.
